items.title: SEBON published a concept paper on implementing intraday trading in Nepal.
items.summary: The concept proposes a phased approach, initially focused on sufficiently liquid securities and investor-protection, risk-management, surveillance and technology requirements.

items.title: SEBON published a concept paper on advance market notice before promoter/founder shareholders sell shares.
items.summary: The proposal concerns advance disclosure before certain promoter/founder shareholder sales and the proposed regulatory framework.

items.title: SEBON listed its Securities Broker Business Strengthening Policy, 2083.
items.summary: A regulatory policy item relevant to brokerage infrastructure and market operations.
